description: How much state-management activity the app is doing and when, plus how often build-heavy frames coincide with it — use with get_rebuilds to answer 'is this rebuild storm driven by state churn'. Counts and timing only: Riverpod sends an app-side buffer offset and provider an element id, neither resolvable to a provider name or value. Counts are NOT transition counts — a provider event means dependents were notified, so one state change in a widget-heavy tree produces many events. Stock Bloc posts nothing itself; a flutter_bloc app appears here only as the provider activity its notifications cause.

buckets.description: How many of the busiest one-second buckets to return.
